brief.symptoms: The producer hangs indefinitely after a batch of messages fails to send.
hints: The producer reports an error after a batch fails to send.
Look at the asyncProducer package - the retryHandler function.
When a batch cannot be sent, the producer should report an error for each message in the batch.
brief.lesson: Returning an error for every message in a failed batch prevents the producer from getting stuck in an infinite retry loop.
